name: gcps_tgff_n1000_CT2_s0_9
model: GCPS model (Zheng, Liang & Xiong, DAES 25, 2021): one CPU runs SW tasks sequentially; every HW task has its own unit; one shared bus carries data between tasks on different sides (same-side edges cost 0); total HW area <= C. Schedule length by LSSP (paper Alg. 1). AR = all_sw_time / schedule length. Costs in ns.
